risks.title: Volatility in raw material prices (cocoa)
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly states that cocoa continues to experience elevated market prices compared to historical levels and that cocoa products represent the primary direct contributor to higher costs. This volatility has a significant direct impact on gross margins and profitability in 2025.

risks.title: Inflationary pressures and supply chain costs
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights ongoing inflationary pressures and higher manufacturing costs throughout 2025. The company had to implement strategic pricing actions in the third quarter to mitigate gross margin pressures, indicating a material impact on results.

risks.title: Changes in global trade policies and customs tariffs
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly indicates that the imposition of tariffs on U.S. imports and retaliatory tariffs had a material negative impact on results in 2025. The company continues to monitor negotiations regarding tariffs on goods from Canada, Mexico and other countries.

risks.title: Changing consumer behaviors and price elasticity
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions changes in consumer behavior and purchasing habits amid evolving macroeconomic pressures. Price elasticity may limit the ability to fully pass through cost increases to consumers.

risks.title: Increased regulations in the food industry
risks.score_rationale: The food industry faces growing laws and regulations including nutrition, date labeling and traceability requirements. The FDA announced in April 2025 the phased removal of approved synthetic colorings, requiring Hershey to remove all FDC certified colors from its snacks by end of 2027.

risks.title: Risks related to acquisitions and integration
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed several recent acquisitions including LesserEvil (November 2025), Sour Strips (November 2024) and Weaver (May 2023). While strategic, these acquisitions carry inherent risks related to integration, realization of synergies and financial performance.
